title: Spent the last few months building tools for my own MT5 accounts
author: br-hm

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: alerts on live vs backtest drift, nice. how does it decide a gap needs a look and isn't just noise from the first 20 trades?

replies.author: br-hm
replies.body: good question. it's not trade count, it's window count. i compare the live account's trailing N day return factor against every historical N day window from the backtest. need at least 20 comparable windows before it flags anything, otherwise it just says "not enough data yet." once there's enough it places the live number by percentile against the backtest's own p5 to p95 range instead of some fixed threshold.
